subject.title: fix(qa): avoid touching operator state during private QA runs

question: Which pre-registration ownership boundary should private QA use: repo-owned QA runner discovery or an explicitly isolated state environment established before the QA command tree is registered?
rationale: Both approaches can prevent operator-state access, but the permanent QA/plugin discovery contract and its ownership boundary need maintainer direction.

options.title: Use repo-owned QA runner inputs
options.body: Make QA command registration discover only source-checkout QA runners and fixtures, never installed operator plugins or state.

options.title: Establish isolated state before registration
options.body: Create and pass an explicit disposable QA state environment before any QA runner or manifest discovery occurs.

recommendation.title: Use repo-owned QA runner inputs
recommendation.body: Make QA command registration discover only source-checkout QA runners and fixtures, never installed operator plugins or state.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied PR and linked issue show direct involvement in the QA launcher boundary, though current-main ownership history was not available here.
